content.short: Nosana is a decentralized AI compute network on Solana connecting developers with idle GPU capacity.
content.description:
Nosana is a pioneering Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) built on Solana, designed to create a scalable and cost-effective marketplace for AI compute power. By connecting AI developers who require high-performance GPU resources with individuals and data centers that have idle capacity, Nosana significantly lowers the barrier to entry for AI inference and model training. This decentralized approach provides a robust alternative to centralized cloud providers, offering up to 90% cost savings for complex computational workloads.

Leveraging Solana's high speed and low latency, Nosana ensures transparent and efficient settlement for compute jobs using the NOS token. The network is built for high reliability and security, providing developers with the essential infrastructure needed to power the next generation of AI-integrated applications. Through its commitment to democratizing access to computing resources, Nosana is a foundational pillar of the decentralized AI economy, empowering participants to monetize their hardware while accelerating technological innovation.
